gates.name: Point-in-time integrity
gates.rule: Every scoring input must exist before the tip-off it predicts; no same-game information.
gates.value: 121/121 games predicted from prior games only

gates.name: Source verification
gates.rule: Every published value carries a link to an official source; unverifiable values blank.

gates.name: Sample sufficiency
gates.rule: At least 300 independently graded predictions before any reward.

gates.name: Out-of-sample positive skill
gates.rule: Bootstrap 95% lower bound of skill score must exceed 0.

gates.name: Luck test
gates.rule: Permutation test p < 0.01 that the observed skill exceeds chance.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.rule: Expected calibration error <= 0.05 and reliability slope within [0.80, 1.20].

gates.name: Dependence accounting
gates.rule: Parlay and same-game legs must use measured dependence, never the independence assumption.
gates.value: measured r(margin,total) = 0.0351; joint model used in S07/S08

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.rule: BH-FDR q < 0.10 across the whole strategy family.
gates.value: min BH q = 0.00e+00 over 15 tests (10 correlations + 5 strategy luck tests)

gates.name: Market price evidence
gates.rule: Positive recognised edge requires official or verifiable closing prices (CLV), not a model's own price.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.rule: Deterministic rebuild, zero broken links, zero unsourced table rows.
gates.value: build.py + verify.py deterministic; see verification report
